Choose the best response for each task.

tasks.prompt: Make the area electrically safe, document symptoms, and identify affected systems.
Separate power, startup, and network evidence; test with known-good components.
Implement the smallest confirmed corrections and replace only failed parts.
Run load, restart, and connectivity tests; document findings and preventive actions.

explanations.task-1: Safety and scope precede technical work.
explanations.task-2: Structured isolation prevents unrelated symptoms from being conflated.
explanations.task-3: Confirmed minimal corrections reduce risk.
explanations.task-4: Multi-layer verification and documentation complete recovery.
